declared_before_run.method: held pore-pressure patch (Dirichlet load); the instrument reads the flux dQ/dt
declared_before_run.observable: the time at which the transient flux excess falls to the MEASURED steady flux — grid-independent because it references no initial value
declared_before_run.prefactor: C = 1/pi = 0.318310 in a^2/D units, from flux(t) = 4 pi D a (1 + a/sqrt(pi D t)) for a sphere held at fixed potential
declared_before_run.direction_vs_relaxation: NOT declared — importing the SLS inequality tau_eps > tau_sigma would assume the answer this run exists to measure

creep_over_relaxation.why: the textbook split between creep and relaxation, measured for a poroelastic medium

grid_invariance.why: the patch is loaded instantaneously, so the initial flux is grid-set; if tau moves with dx then this method's number is partly the mesh, not the medium
